response.original_title: ファイナル湘南台。～大切な場所と仲間と思い出を～
response.overview: Final Shonandai ~A Place, Friends, and Memories That Are Important to Me~ was a professional wrestling event promoted by Tokyo Joshi Pro-Wrestling (TJPW), held on December 10, 2026 at Shonandai Cultural Center in Fujisawa, Kanagawa, Japan. It served as longtime star Yuki Kamifuku's final hometown show before her in-ring retirement at the end of December 2026.
